repository.name: data-service
repository.description: The Data Service is a FastAPI microservice (Python 3.13) that serves satellite imagery tiles (GOES-19 ABI and GOES-19 GLM), radar data, and weather station information via REST API. It syncs tile data from an S3/SeaweedFS bucket — populated by the tiles-processor service — to local storage, and uses Redis for caching and index management.
